meta.title: SnoozeYouLose — Cozy Farm Sim meets Galgame
meta.description: A cozy farming simulator fused with branching visual-novel storytelling. Plant, harvest, live the story, and mod it your own way.

hero.title: SnoozeYouLose
hero.subtitle: A cozy farm-sim x Galgame hybrid. Grow your farm, live the branching story, and mod it your own way.

features.title: A few things you'll love
features.subtitle: A laid-back farm life with a story that bends to your choices.

farming.title: Farming & Planting
farming.desc: Till the soil, sow seeds, water your crops, and harvest across a living 3D farm.

galgame.title: Branching Story
galgame.desc: Galgame-style dialogue where every choice sets flags and reshapes your route.

mods.title: Mod System
mods.desc: A data-driven mod architecture — add crops, items, NPCs and scripts without code.

gamepad.title: Gamepad Support
gamepad.desc: Full PS5 DualSense support with aim-to-interact and haptic feedback.

download.title: Download SnoozeYouLose
download.subtitle: Free and open source. Available for macOS, Windows and Linux.
